doc.summary: Shared text kernel for the LazyOwn framework.
doc.description:
Single-implementation rule: the live helpers live in ``utils`` (used
by the CLI and C2). This module keeps only ``strip_ansi``, the one
extraction the framework actually imports. The rest of the historic
``utils.py`` fork was removed because every copy had diverged and
zero callers (see ``tests/test_single_implementation.py``).

doc.summary: Remove ANSI escape sequences and readline markers from a string.
doc.description:
Handles standard escape codes (``[...m``), extended unicode
escape initiators (````, ````), CSI sequences, and the
````/```` (SOH/STX) delimiters that ``render_prompt`` emits
so readline can measure prompt width.

returns.description: Clean text without ANSI codes or readline control markers.
